ai.title: How to predict the behavior of molecules from scant data
ai.brief: Discovering new molecules for specific uses is a major driver of progress in a wide variety of industries, whether it’s pharmaceutical companies looking for new drugs, or electronics or energy companies seeking new materials with particular properties. But it’s also largely a trial-and-error process, because there is not yet any way to perfectly predict how a given chemical compound will behave in terms of the myriad different properties and responses materials can exhibit. Recent progress has been made on using artificial intelligence and machine learning to supplement or speed up laborious calculations based on physical principles that can at least provide some initial guidance on which compounds might be worth synthesizing and testing.

sec.title: White House Network Appears in Global Residential Proxy Traffic
sec.brief: S. S. S. 3M set-top boxes into proxy servers Layer3 Intel says it found residential proxy traffic leaving through the White House network. The researchers spotted it while browsing their new Residential Proxy Observatory, a tool that gives a global view of residential proxy and anonymized internet activity. “While our team was looking through it, we noticed residential proxy exit activity on AS2650 . ” reads the report published by Layer3.
